notes.title: The UI Update
notes.notes:
Pretty Huge Update, here's the wall of text changelog:

- Redone start menu.
- Whole main menu redone, including all submenus.
- New menu sounds.
- No more cosmetics levels, just money.
- You no longer earn money from finishing levels, but enemies now drop money on death that can be picked up.
- Removed movement effects category of cosmetics, might add them back later.
- Added a new player skin.
- Small balances.
- Various bugfixes.

notes.title: One Life now with keybinds!
notes.notes:
The new keybind menu can be found under controls, note that it won't appear when using a controller.

The sounds for interacting with the buttons in the menu are now nicer.

2 New cheat codes, these codes were from a nearly 3 year old build of One Life, they do completely different things now but it'll be fun for people who somehow still remember them (or people who extract the source code lol).
